notes.content:
[h1]※  ASIA / NA server instability problem has been confirmed and is being corrected. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

<Estimated time>
 -KST 15:10 ~ 15:30 (about 20 minutes)
 -PST 22:10 ~22:30 (about 20 minutes)
[/h1]

Hello.
This is the GranAge Team.

We would like to notify everyone about the April 7th update.
For more information, please refer to [Patch note v0408_1].

[u][b][Update schedule][/b][/u]
[u][b]-KST: 4/8 (Thu) 12:00 ~ 15:00 (3 hours)
-PST: 4/7 (Wed) 19:00 ~ 22:00 (3 hours)[/b][/u]

[u][b][Patch note v0408_1][/b][/u]

1. Dungeon entry level limit will be removed. The level displayed is the recommended enter level.

2. The difficulty level and rewards of the [Epic] Quest have been changed.
-Now, the difficulty of the [Epic] Quest has been increased, and the overall reward has also been increased.

3. [Next Dungeon], [Exit], [Rechallenge] UI has been added so that you can quickly proceed to the next dungeon after receiving the boss reward at the hunting ground.

4. We noticed that after clearing the Dungeon, unable to wear the newly acquired equipment due to level requirement may negatively affect the gaming experience.
Therefore, the levels of equipment dropped in different regions have been adjusted.
  Ex.) Lost Castle 30Lv -> 25Lv
         Thorn Forest 40Lv -> 35Lv
         Cahill 45Lv -> 40Lv

5. Territory Battle
-Multiple-occupation penalty has been increased. (Previously there was no penalty for waiting scores)
[u][b]In the case of having one territory occupied previous to the battle, the final score will be the victory points and waiting points divided by two.
In the case of having two territories occupied previous to the battle, the final score will be the victory points and waiting points divided by three.
* When the territory war begins at a territory, the given terrirory will be freed, so it will not be counted as occupied by any Guild.[/b][/u]

-This is an event for activation, and for the time being, the cost to apply for the battle will be reduced to 10,000 Grans.
-Brayton Territory Battle is added. (ASIA)

6. CP consumption rate is applied to Chain Arts cards.
-Assuming that a card with a CP consumption rate of 50% is being placed in the first Chain Art slot, and 50% of the first 1000 CP is consumed, which means the actual CP consumed is 500.
-If the CP consumption rate of the Chain Arts that you placed in the front of Chain Arts chain is low, it can be used more often.
-Usually, the Chain Arts that are strong or with wider range have higher CP consumption rates, so it is recommended to put them in the slots further down the Chain Arts chain.

7. The difficulty of the Cahill area has been adjusted. Some weak dungeons are upgraded.

8. The motion where the character pauses for a while during the activation of Runaway mode has been removed.

9. The level 24 achievement gift, a fixed-period Epic weapon with level 6 enhancement has been changed to an Epic weapon with level 0 enhancement but no longer expires.

10. For your convenience, now the Enhancement UI will open immediately when you right-click the Enhancement Stone item in the inventory.

11. In Normal/Hard difficulty, the dropping rate of rare equipment that matches your character’s class is now very high. 

12. Grand Stadium inactivation time has been reduced and application time has been increased. (The interval between Grand Athletics is the same as before, but the application period is now longer.)

13. We have fixed a bug that caused abnormal damage due to overflow when a powerful attack made to a high-defense character (such as a Crusader with a defense buff turned on).

14. In the Arena, we have fixed the bug where the room status remains as [In combat] when the game crashed during the battle.

15. Pastel dyes and Spirit Powder obtained through gathering are no longer used, so they will be removed from the system.

16. Epic Weapon & Equipment Box will be changed to only drop item that matches the character’s class.

17. New dress released.

18. Valdr's Resurrection Stone has been added to the Cash Shop.

Thank you!

[list]

[/list]

[list]
[*]Movement Speed → Attack Power
[*]All Elemental Resistance → Skill Damage
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921496/9cb0e3fa9f5dbf365cb4672770f1abaa8b0f71f8.png[/img]

[list]
[*]The [Please try again after a while] message is no longer displayed.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Mole game mode added.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921496/646bc1afd0f2370e8cb25b5d4dba45a9537570b8.png[/img]

[list]
[*]The Sichuan Mahjong shape tiles have been replaced.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921496/495e011a684ffe33092a8d205c5fecf90b0e641a.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Magic Rating +5 Weapon Item: 15Lv → 17Lv
[*]Epic +6 weapon item: 22Lv → 24Lv
[/list]

27. The Chain Arts system has been improved.
[list]
[*]Additional attack power according to the Chain Arts grade is increased.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921496/f6b0750731f6fe2d655349207cac62a0a029bb17.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Added buffs to Chain Arts.
> If you have a card with a rare level or higher, the damage per card is increased to %.
(Rare 1% / Epic 2% / Legend 5%)
> If you level up the Chain Arts card, the value increases.
(Rare 0.15% / Epic 0.3% / Legend 0.5%)
[/list]

[i]Ex) If you have 10 rare 1Lv + 2 rare 5Lv [12*1% + 8*0.15% = 13.2% attack power increase]
   However, the number after decimal point will not be included in the total value.[/i]

28. Weapon enhancement formula has been improved.
[list]
[*]Changed to apply the enhancement value only to the basic attack power of the weapon.
The value increased by the enhancement is now displayed on the weapon. 
[/list]

[i]※ We have increased the weapon enhancement level so that the change of enhancement formula does not greatly affect the current outcome.[/i]

[list]
Ex) 
+10 100% → 170%
+11 151% → 220%
+12 216% → 295%
+13 296% → 400%
[/list]

29. Adjusted the dungeon's difficulty balance.

Thank you

[*] PST: 1/26 (Tue) 19:00 ~ 22:00 (3 hours)
[/b][/h1]

[h1][b][Patch note v0127_4][/b][/h1]
1. The difficulty level of the Shadow Citadel Death Dungeon has been significantly lowered.

2. The calculation formula of the hit / avoidance probability has been changed.
  Character’s base accuracy rate changed from 70% to 90%

[b][existing][/b]
A: Target evasion rate%
B: Attacker accuracy% + target avoidance% + 1% per level difference

[list]
[*]Evasion Chance: (A / B) %
[/list]

[b][change][/b]
A: Target evasion rate%
B: Attacker accuracy%

[list]
[*] Hit Chance: (B-A) %
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921496/36ddb9d7a0aabd36c199bee1620acbf2ef1ab889.png[/img]

11. Changed the item on the Ananshi to be transparent.

16. When sending mail to another character within the account, the trading ban has been removed.

17. The [Death Coin] item that can be obtained when clearing the death dungeon is changed to a binding item.

18. The dice function has been added.
[list][*] If you enter "/dice" in the chat window, the dice results from 0 to 99 are randomly output.
[/list]

19. New content [Territory War] has been added.
[list]
[*] You can apply through the Territory war icon at the top right.
[*] You can apply from level 21.
[*] Teams are randomly assigned, and the team with the opponent's flag's HP set to 0 or with more HP gauge at the end wins.
[*] Team Red moves to Ellein Territory, and Team Blue moves to Esther Territory to attack the opponent's flag.
[*] PVP between users is also possible, and if you die, you will be moved to the forgotten island for 20 seconds.
[*] Opening hours: 7 / 10 / 19 / 22 o’clock (20 minutes)
[*] Reward: Freiya Coin (KO Victory-4 Coins / Victory-3 Coins / Loss-2 Coins / KO Loss-1 Coin)

  - A confirmation message will prompt as the equipment may break if it is reinforced more than +6.

  - All chain arts have been reorganized. 
    The more you grow and synthesize Chain Arts, the better you feel.

  - We have introduced a growth system for Chain Arts, and we have graded it according to the existing Chain Art motions.

notes.title: GranAge December 2nd Update Notice (KST)
notes.content:
Hello.
This is GrandAge team.

We will notice you of the GranAge update schedule.
Please refer to [Patch Note v1202_1].

[h1][b][Update Schedule]
KST - Wed, 2 Dec 11:00 ~ 13:00 (2 hours)
PST - Tue, 1 Dec 18:00 ~ 20:00 (2 hours)[/b][/h1]

* Please be reminded to avoid accessing GranAge during the maintenance period.
* To access after the maintenance period, please sign out from steam and sign in again for the client update.

[h1][b][Patch Note v1202_1][/b][/h1]
1 Equipment notation has been changed.			
   > The crown shape marked above the rare level equipment was removed, and the color of each level has been introduced.

2 Cookie House's Imperial Mission quest rewards have been reduced.			
   > The reward of the quest is good for a week, but this is a daily quest. Due to excessive compensation, the reward has been adjusted to a daily quest level.	

3. The dash distance required for dash attack has been slightly reduced. 			
   > The dash can be activated a little faster than before.		

4. The crafting material for making a recipe has been changed.			
   > The material requirement for the crafting recipe was set too low. It was at the level that 100 to hundreds of lowest level potions could be easily procuded with the materials that are automatically acquired by simply turning on the mining skill for a day.	
      So, first, let us say that we have to make corrections.

      In the last week's update, the information in that part was omitted, which caused more 
      inconvenience. On top of everything, please accept our apology.
	
      However, since the mining part is the basis of the economic balance, it is absolutely necessary to be corrected, We appreciate your understanding.		
      
      [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921496/69e76e38550ee9de8b644e1899f9ae00525688a5.png[/img]

5. Daily quests of athletic has been removed.			
   > We have deleted the daily quests by time zone because the time zones of our players are all different.
		
6. Character level requested for learning mining, logging and fishing have been adjusted.		
   > mining: 15Lv, logging: 17Lv, fishing: 19Lv.			

7. The Challengia system is going to be improved. We will announce the details in a later notice. The system is currently applied as below.			
   > Challengia rewards will be given directly as challenge stones.			
   > If you win the Challengia competition, you get two Challenge stones and one if you lose.			
			
8. The ChainArt's Level-Up User Interface has been modified to be more intuitive and convenient for using.
			
9. ChainArts have been improved, so they can be used more often.
   > The recovery speed of the SP has been increased.		
      Each time you hit a monster, the amount of SP acquired was reduced slightly.		
      The minimum SP value required to activate ChainArts is lowered. So ChainArts can be used when the SP is more than half charged.	

10. After clearing the Dungeon, HP/MP recovery costs have been reduced to the 30% of current level. 

11. When you bring your mouse cursor to the battery mark, it will indicate when the fatigue level is reset.	
		
12. The color of the expiration date has been changed to make it stand out in the item details window.			

13. If you left the dungeon without clearing the boss, the durability of the unequipted items in inventory will no longer be reduced.		
			
14. If the acquired equipment is wearable, the equipment will be marked with a red dot in inventory. 
		
15. The reward for the Extra Mission will be changed.			
    > Drop a free coin or gran. (Low probability gives a jackpot reward)			
			
16. In the Status window, the weapon position in the Equipment has changed.			
    > The weapon position in the Equipment went down one space to match the dress window.		
			
17. The start cycle and rewards of the Grand Athletic Association  have been changed.			
    > Start Cycle: Start every 10 minutes			
    > Reward: If you achieved your goal (goal-in) after participating in the Grand Athletic Association, you will receive [strike]5 to 15[/strike] 10 to 15 athletic stones according to your goal achievement rank.	

18. You can exchange the athletic stones with a jewelry box or a playstone by visiting the 'Item Exchange' at the 'Event Exchager' NPC.			
    > The jewelry box will give you items sold in gold			
    > Playstone will recover the fatigue level of character. 
			
19. The dress preview feature is added.			
    > If you click the preview button (Dress class box) in the cash shop, you can try dressing up your character in advance.
    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38921496/e6358b4497145f358df07a3ed0ad0c9c1c66f59f.png[/img]

[h1][b][Update Preview][/b][/h1]
1. NA (North America) server will be open.	
    > In order to reduce the lag phenomenon experienced by members in North America/Europe, a new server, North America/Europe, will be opened soon.
    > The server will be located in the North America region.
		
2. ChainArts are being renewed.
    > We are improving the balance and composition of ChainArts so that more powerful ChainArts can be obtained through the combination of ChainArts.
		
3. We are developing PvP Battlefield contents.	
    > We are preparing content that allows multiple players to compete through it.
Acquisition and reinforcement of equipment is important, but the skillful control of character cannot be ignored. It is a content that determines the strongest player in the GranAge by competing between users through high-end equipment and skillfull character control. Hope you all look forward to it. 

[h1][b][Event schedule][/b][/h1]
We plan to hold an event in connection with the change of the Grand Athletics.
During the event, the amount of athletic stone acquisition is doubled.

- KST : 12/2 After update ~ 12/9 before update (About 7 days)
- PST : 12/1 After update ~ 12/8 before update (About 7 days)
 
[h1][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h1]		
1. Fixed a bug where clicking the button continuously while leveling up the ChainArt would cause the connection to break.

2. Characters with less than 14 Lv cannot participate in the Grand Athletic Association, but there was an error that the opening sound of the Grand Athletic Association could be heard.  
We fixed the error so that the opening sound of the Grand Athletics event would no longer be heard for characters under 14Lv.

3. Fixed a problem in which activated ChainArts' linkage breaks when a notification message prompts while hitting both sides of the door in the boss battle.	
		
[h1][b][Violation Notice]	[/b][/h1]	
According to the character's activity log, accounts with characters who have committed actions such as cheating, manipulation, or bug abuse will be banned from accessing the game.	

	Sanctioned characters as below: 	
        Character name : Ada***t / Ada****X	

		
Thanks.

notes.title: GranAge November 19th Update Log (KST)
notes.content:
Hello, this is Grand Age Team.
​
Thank you for telling us about the improvements to be made while playing after Early Access opens.
There was a lot of content, but I would like to inform you about the first patch.
Please refer to [Tip of GranAge] [patch note v1118_1] [About Next Update].
​
And we will update the patch note during our maintenance on November 19th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 10:00~12:10 (KST).{November 18th, 17:00 ~19:10(PT)}

[b]Add 10 min[/b]

* You cannot access the game during maintenance.
* After maintenance, please be sure to reconnect after Steam is terminated for client updates.


[h1][u][b][Tip of GranAge][/b][/u][/h1]
​
1. Fatigue system
​
   Each dungeon has a set of fatigue levels. Fatigue consumption is reduced by the following conditions.
​
	a. The amount of fatigue consumed is determined by the clear-time of each dungeon.
	b. The higher the rank, the less fatigue consumption.
	c. Fatigue consumption is reduced according to the dungeon clear rank.
​
2. Early Access Character Data
​
   Character data acquired by playing during Early Access will be maintained even after the live service of GranAeg. However, if a serious error occurs, it may be initialized before the live service, and all payments will be refunded upon initialization.
​
3. Epic level Accessories
​
    Epic level accessories can be obtained with a certain probability when you clear the Master Dungeon.

4. Regarding the occurrence of lag during party play
​
   During a party, some lag may occur depending on the location of the player. To improve this, through the application of regional party servers we are constantly testing to improve the lag. We are working hard to improve in other ways as well.
When applied to actual service, we will inform you through notice.



[h1][u][b][patch note v1118_1][/b][/u][/h1]
​
1. ChainArts
​
   - Instructions on how to use chain arts are displayed in the chain arts window.
​
2. Auction house
​
    - A shortcut button of auction has been added.
    - Registration fee is increased when registering to sell cash items.
    - When trading cash items at the auction house, a link of cancellation policy is displayed in the transaction confirmation window.
    - We made a bigger difference in appearance between the currency unit Gran and Cash.
​
3. Random Dress Box
​
    - you can see the information of random dress box which are consisted of what kind of items. 

4. Character resurrection

    - When a character in the dungeon dies, a resurrection is displayed at the top of the screen to express that the resurrection item is necessary for resurrection.

5. Sword Singer Related Items / Golden Trust's Scream Item / PvP Exclusive Equipment Related Items
    - It will be deleted all items because of incorrect settings. However, for those who have items, we will compensate to you with 10,000 Gran per item, and the PvP exclusive equipment will be compensated to you with 1,000 Gran per item.  (We are apologized for inconvenience) 
    - The items will not be spawned in game any more. 
​

6. Cash charging unit
​
   -The unit expressed when charging the cash is expressed as $(USD).
​
7. Quest change
​
   - Challenger quests of time-table will be deleted at once.
   - Gold Dungeon 2 ~ 4 quests of Sanctuary will be deleted.
​
8. Grand Athletic Meeting
​
   - The Grand Athletic Meeting was held so frequently that the occurrence period was changed a little longer.
​
9. After selecting the dungeon level of hard mode, when the dungeon is selected again, the bug that changed to normal mode has been fixed.
​
10. When playing a dungeon, the difficulty level is too low to make it suitable for party play.
​
11. The difficulty of hard mode and master mode has been increased. In master mode, there is a chance that epic level accessories will be drop.

12. Corrected that the English expression of the community and the guild window was not unusual.

[h1][u][b][About Next Update]
​[/b][/u][/h1]
1. ChainArts
​
    We plan to modify the ChainArts system to increase the value setting and usability of ChainArts.
    We set the direction so that the effect of the chain arts card becomes more pronounced as the star grade increases.
​
2. Fatigue recovery items
​
   We are planning to add items that can recover some of the fatigue.
​
3. English script
​
   The English script is constantly being improved. As soon as it is modified, we will update it during maintenance.
